A Paper to Draw JointJS Diagrams on

jointjs_paper.Rd

Set up a sheet of paper to draw jointjs diagrams on. This class can be used to define the paper specifications. These specifications are needed when creating a widget with jointjs().

Methods

Public methods

  • jointjs_paper$new()

  • jointjs_paper$get_list()

  • jointjs_paper$clone()

jointjs_paper$new()

Initiate a paper object

Usage

jointjs_paper$new(
  width,
  height,
  background = list(color = "#E9ECEF"),
  gridSize = 20,
  drawGrid = list(name = "dot", args = list(color = "#808080", thickness = 1)),
  interactive = TRUE,
  snapLinks = list(radius = 20),
  defaultLink = jointjs::jointjs_cell$new(NULL, "standard.Link", .connection =
    list(stroke = "#2C3E50", strokeWidth = 2), `.marker-target` = list(fill = "#2C3E50",
    d = "M 10 0 L 0 5 L 10 10 z")),
  validateConnection =
    htmlwidgets::JS("\n        function(cellViewS, magnetS, cellViewT, magnetT, end, linkView) {\n          if (cellViewS === cellViewT) return false;\n          return cellViewT && cellViewT.model.isElement();\n        }\n      "),
  ...
)

Arguments

width

Paper width in CSS units.

height

Paper height in CSS units.

background

A named list with background properties. The list can contain the elements color, image (an URL for a background image), position (x and y coordinate for the image), size of the background image (width and height), repeat a CSS background-repeat property, quality coefficient for image quality, opacity in the range of 0-1, watermarkAngle in degrees. If set to FALSE no background is drawn.

gridSize

gridSize in CSS units

drawGrid

A named list specifying how to draw a grid on the paper. An element name can use any of these predefined grid patterns: "dot" (default), "fixedDot", "mesh", or "doubleMesh". Use an element named args to specify pattern properties. If set to FALSE, no grid is drawn.

interactive

Use a logical value to enable or disable all interactive elements. Or use a named list of interactions with logical values to enable or disable specific interactions

snapLinks

A logical value indicating if links should be snapped to magnets. Or a named list with element radius in pixels, giving the distance for snapping links.

defaultLink

Default properties for links. A jointjs_link class object.

validateConnection

A JavaScript function that validates if a connection between a specific source and target is allowed. It should return a logical value.

...

Other options passed to the JointJS JavaScript library.
